clauses.title: CL-D124 records the removal of the Issue candidate field
requires: Version 2's Issue correlation and Issue finding record declare no `candidateIdentity`
Version 1 keeps its rule: its Issue finding record still requires a candidate identity.
The version-2 pull-request finding record keeps its schema; its validator already refuses `candidateIdentity`.

clauses.title: The version-2 Issue schema declares no candidate
requires: for (const k of issue ? ISSUE_CORR_REQ : CORR_REQ)

clauses.title: The Issue Skill names no version-2 Issue candidate
requires: The Issue correlation and finding record have no candidate field (CL-D124).

clauses.title: The gate contract names no version-2 Issue candidate
requires: Issue records carry only candidate identity, fixed revised passage, and snapshot assignment under version 1; under version 2 they carry no candidate identity (CL-D124).
The Issue correlation names none of them and no candidate (CL-D124); it carries `issueSpec`, a finding or confirmation binds to its gate by `issueSpec`, and an Issue record names no candidate.
